      stack << {y, x}
    end
  end

  f[0][i]=false
  f[1][i*n]=false
  f[2][(n-1)*n+i]=false
  f[3][(i+1)*n-1]=false
  u,d=i,n-1-i
  n.times{|j|
    k=[j,n-1-j].min
    if u<=d
      w[0][i*n+j]=w[1][j*n+i]=[k+1,u].min
    else
      w[0][i*n+j]=w[1][j*n+i]=[k+1,d+2].min
    end
    if d<=u
      w[2][i*n+j]=w[3][j*n+i]=[k+1,d].min
    else
      w[2][i*n+j]=w[3][j*n+i]=[k+1,u+2].min
    end
  }
}

ctypedef np.int_t DTYPE_t
def main():
    cdef int n=int(input())
    cdef list p=list(map(int,input().split()))
    cdef int i,j,x,y,t
    cdef DTYPE_t [:, :] ans
    cdef DTYPE_t [:, :] c
    ans=np.zeros([n+1, n+1], DTYPE)
    c=np.ones([n+1, n+1], DTYPE)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            ans[i][j]=min(i-1,j-1,n-i,n-j)
    def f(int x,int y):
        for i,j in [(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)]:
            if 1<=x+i<=n and 1<=y+j<=n:
                if ans[x][y]+c[x][y]<ans[x+i][y+j]:
                    ans[x+i][y+j]-=1
                    f(x+i,y+j)
    t=0
    for i in p:
        y=i%n
        if y==0:
            y=n
        x=(i+n-1)//n
        c[x][y]=0
        t+=ans[x][y]
        f(x,y)
    return t

module mod_graph
  implicit none
  integer(8), parameter :: inf = 1000000000000000000_8

  type item
    integer :: id = 0                             !番号
    integer(8) :: wt = 0_8                        !距離の合計
 end type item

  type priorityqueue
    integer :: num = 0                            !要素数
    type(item), pointer :: heap(:) => null()      !配列へのポインタの大きさは無指定
  contains
    !final :: finalizei
 end type priorityqueue

  type edge                                       !辺のこと．ここから可変長配列の実装
     integer :: fm = 0, to = 0, cp = 0, rv = 0
     !from,to,cpはff法の辺の容量，rvは逆辺のリスト上のインデックスの情報
    integer(8) :: wt = 0_8                        !重み(距離とか)
 end type edge

  type arraylist                                   !メソッドの実装，辺に番号付け？
    integer :: num = 0
    type(edge), pointer :: arr(:) => null()
  contains
    procedure :: add => adde
    procedure :: bellman_ford => bellman_ford
    !final :: finalizee
 end type arraylist

  type graph                                       !メソッドの実装，辺と番号，使用状況
    type(arraylist), pointer :: egs(:) => null()   !隣接リスト
    logical, pointer :: used(:) => null()          !dfsで使う
  contains                                         !type文の中にcontain文を入れる
    procedure :: add => add                       !typeの外のサブルーチンへのポインタ
    procedure :: dijkstra => dijkstra
    procedure :: ford_fulkerson => ford_fulkerson
    !final :: finalize
 end type graph

  interface graph                          !interfaceは安全に関数を引数として渡す
    module procedure :: newg               !コンストラクタ
  end interface graph

contains

  function newi(id,wt) result(ret)   !idとwtをitem型のretに入れる
    integer, intent(in) :: id
    integer(8), intent(in) :: wt
    type(item) :: ret
    ret%id = id
    ret%wt = wt
  end function newi

  subroutine swapi(a,b)               !item型であるa,bを入れ替える
    type(item), intent(inout) :: a, b
    type(item) :: c
    c = a
    a = b
    b = c
  end subroutine swapi

  subroutine appendi(a)                         !aの配列長をnから2nにする.O(n)かかる
    type(item), pointer, intent(inout) :: a(:)
    integer :: n
    type(item), allocatable :: tmp(:)
    n = size(a)                                 !配列の要素の合計数
    allocate(tmp(n))
    tmp = a
    deallocate(a)
    allocate(a(2*n))
    a(1:n) = tmp
    deallocate(tmp)
  end subroutine appendi

  function lessi(a,b) result(ret)         !bのwtが大きければ真，そうでなければ偽
    type(item), intent(in) :: a, b
    logical :: ret
    ret = a%wt < b%wt
  end function lessi

  subroutine finalizei(pq)               !pqのリセット
    type(priorityqueue), intent(inout) :: pq
    if (associated(pq%heap)) deallocate(pq%heap)
    pq%num = 0
  end subroutine finalizei

  subroutine offer(pq,it)                !item型であるitをpqに追加する
    type(priorityqueue), intent(inout) :: pq
    type(item), intent(in) :: it
    integer :: i, j
    if (.not.associated(pq%heap)) allocate(pq%heap(1)) !参照先がなければ1番目参照
    if (pq%num == size(pq%heap)) call appendi(pq%heap) !配列長をnから2nに
    pq%num = pq%num+1
    pq%heap(pq%num) = it                 !新たな数値は最後尾に
    i = pq%num
    do while (i > 1)   !逆転がなくなるまで上にあげていく(小さいほうが上)
      j = i/2
      if (lessi(pq%heap(i),pq%heap(j))) call swapi(pq%heap(i),pq%heap(j))
      i = j
    end do
  end subroutine offer

  function poll(pq) result(ret)   !一番上のitem型を取り出す(pqから削除する)
    type(priorityqueue), intent(inout) :: pq
    type(item) :: ret
    integer :: n, i, j
    n = pq%num
    ret = pq%heap(1)
    pq%heap(1) = pq%heap(n)
    pq%num = pq%num-1
    i = 1
    do while (2*i < n)   !最後尾のものを一番上に上げたので，逆転がなくなるまで下ろす
      j = 2*i
      if (j+1 < n .and. lessi(pq%heap(j+1),pq%heap(j))) j = j+1
      if (lessi(pq%heap(j),pq%heap(i))) call swapi(pq%heap(j),pq%heap(i))
      i = j
    end do
  end function poll

  function newe(to,wt,fm,cp,rv) result(ret)   !新しいedgeの生成
    integer, intent(in) :: to
    integer(8), intent(in) :: wt
    integer, intent(in), optional :: fm, cp, rv
    !省略可能な因数の利用(fmはbf法，cp,rvはff法で使用)
    type(edge) :: ret
    if (present(fm)) ret%fm = fm
    ret%to = to
    ret%wt = wt
    if (present(cp) .and. present(rv)) then
      ret%cp = cp
      ret%rv = rv
    end if
  end function newe

  subroutine appende(a)                        !配列長をnから2nに
    type(edge), pointer, intent(inout) :: a(:)
    integer :: n
    type(edge), allocatable :: tmp(:)
    n = size(a)
    allocate(tmp(n))
    tmp = a
    deallocate(a)
    allocate(a(2*n))
    a(1:n) = tmp
    deallocate(tmp)
  end subroutine appende

  function lesse(a,b) result(ret)              !bのwtが大きければ真
    type(edge), intent(in) :: a, b
    logical :: ret
    ret = a%wt < b%wt
  end function lesse

  subroutine finalizee(list)                   !リセット
    type(arraylist), intent(inout) :: list
    if (associated(list%arr)) deallocate(list%arr)
    list%num = 0
  end subroutine finalizee

  subroutine adde(list,e)   !メソッドの処理を書くとき，引数はclass文で宣言.edgeをlistに追加
    class(arraylist), intent(inout) :: list
    type(edge), intent(in) :: e
    if (.not.associated(list%arr)) allocate(list%arr(1))
    if (list%num == size(list%arr)) call appende(list%arr)
    list%num = list%num+1
    list%arr(list%num) = e   !最後尾に追加
  end subroutine adde

  function newg(n) result(ret)   !n番目のgraph型の枠をつくる
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    type(graph) :: ret
    allocate(ret%egs(n))
  end function newg

  subroutine add(g,fm,to,wt,cp)   !graph型にデータを追加
    class(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: fm, to
    integer, intent(in), optional :: cp
    integer(8) :: wt
    if (present(cp)) then
      call adde(g%egs(fm),newe(to,wt,cp=cp,rv=g%egs(to)%num))
      call adde(g%egs(to),newe(fm,wt,cp=0,rv=g%egs(fm)%num-1))
    else
      call adde(g%egs(fm),newe(to,wt))
    end if
  end subroutine add

  subroutine finalize(g)      !リセット
    type(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer :: i
    if (associated(g%used)) deallocate(g%used)
    if (.not.associated(g%egs)) return
    do i = 1, size(g%egs)
      call finalizee(g%egs(i))
    end do
    deallocate(g%egs)
  end subroutine finalize

  function dijkstra(g,s,d) result(ret)   !ダイクストラ法ABC168D，sはstart
    class(graph), intent(in) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: s
    integer(8) :: ret(size(g%egs))     !graph中のlistの数だけ配列をつくる．最短距離を格納
    type(priorityqueue) :: pq
    type(item) :: it
    type(edge) :: e
    integer :: i
    integer :: d(size(g%egs)-1)
    ret = inf
    ret(s) = 0_8
    call offer(pq,newi(s,ret(s)))   !pqにstartの番号とret(s)=0からなるitem型を追加
    do while (pq%num > 0)           !すべて吐き出す
      it = poll(pq)                 !一番上のものを取り出す．次に使う頂点
      if (it%wt > ret(it%id)) cycle
      do i = 1, g%egs(it%id)%num
        e = g%egs(it%id)%arr(i)     !取り出したitemのid番目のlistをeとする
        if (ret(e%to) > ret(it%id)+(e%wt)*d(e%to)) then   !今いる場所からの方が近い
          ret(e%to) = ret(it%id)+(e%wt)*d(e%to)   !最短経路の更新
          call offer(pq,newi(e%to,ret(e%to)))
        end if
      end do
    end do
    call finalizei(pq)
  end function dijkstra

  recursive subroutine dfs_bf(g,u)
    type(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    integer :: i, v
    g%used(u) = .true.
    do i = 1, g%egs(u)%num
      v = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%to
      if (g%used(v)) cycle
      call dfs_bf(g,v)
    end do
  end subroutine dfs_bf

  function bellman_ford(es,s,t) result(ret)   !sはスタート，tはゴール
    class(arraylist), intent(in) :: es
    integer, intent(in) :: s, t
    integer(8) :: ret
    integer :: n, i, fm, to, step
    integer(8) :: wt
    logical :: updated
    integer(8), allocatable :: tmp(:)
    type(graph) :: gs, gt
    type(arraylist) :: reach
    n = 0
    do i = 1, es%num
      n = max(n,es%arr(i)%fm,es%arr(i)%to)
    end do
    gs = newg(n)
    gt = newg(n)
    allocate(gs%used(n),gt%used(n))
    gs%used = .false.
    gt%used = .false.
    do i = 1, es%num
      fm = es%arr(i)%fm
      to = es%arr(i)%to
      wt = es%arr(i)%wt
      call add(gs,fm,to,wt)
      call add(gt,to,fm,wt)
    end do
    call dfs_bf(gs,s)
    call dfs_bf(gt,t)
    n = 0
    do i = 1, es%num
      fm = es%arr(i)%fm
      to = es%arr(i)%to
      if (gs%used(fm) .and. gt%used(fm) .and. gs%used(to) .and. gt%used(to)) then
        call adde(reach,es%arr(i))
        n = max(n,fm,to)
      end if
    end do
    call finalize(gs)
    call finalize(gt)
    allocate(tmp(n))
    tmp = inf
    tmp(s) = 0_8
    step = 0
    updated = .true.
    ret = inf
    do while (updated)
      updated = .false.
      do i = 1, reach%num
        fm = reach%arr(i)%fm
        to = reach%arr(i)%to
        wt = reach%arr(i)%wt
        if (tmp(to) > tmp(fm)+wt) then
          tmp(to) = tmp(fm)+wt
          updated = .true.
        end if
      end do
      step = step+1
      if (step > n) then
        ret = -inf
        exit
      end if
    end do
    if (ret == inf) ret = tmp(t)
    deallocate(tmp)
    call finalizee(reach)
  end function bellman_ford

  recursive function dfs_ff(g,u,t,f) result(ret)
    class(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: u, t, f          !uはスタート,tはゴール？
    integer :: ret
    integer :: i, v, cp, rv
    ret = f
    if (u == t) return
    g%used(u) = .true.
    do i = 1, g%egs(u)%num
      v = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%to
      cp = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%cp
      if (g%used(v) .or. cp <= 0) cycle
      ret = dfs_ff(g,v,t,min(f,cp))
      rv = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%rv
      if (ret > 0) then
        g%egs(u)%arr(i)%cp = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%cp-ret
        g%egs(v)%arr(rv)%cp = g%egs(v)%arr(rv)%cp+ret
        return
      end if
    end do
    ret = 0
  end function dfs_ff

  function ford_fulkerson(g,s,t) result(ret)   !最大流，最小カットを求める
    class(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: s, t                !スタート，ゴール
    integer :: ret
    integer :: f
    ret = 0
    if (associated(g%used) .and. size(g%used) /= size(g%egs)) deallocate(g%used)
    if (.not.associated(g%used)) allocate(g%used(size(g%egs)))
    do
      g%used = .false.
      f = dfs_ff(g,s,t,1000000000)
      if (f == 0) then
        deallocate(g%used)
        return
      end if
      ret = ret+f
    end do
  end function ford_fulkerson

end module mod_graph

program joker
  implicit none
  integer :: n, p(250000) = 0, h(0:501, 0:501) = 0, i, j, k
  integer :: di(4) = (/0, 1, 0, -1/), dj(4) = (/1, 0, -1, 0/)
  logical :: u(0:501, 0:501) = .false.
  integer(8) :: m = 0
  read(*,*) n
  read(*,*) p(1:n * n)
  do i = 1, n
    do j = 1, n
      h(i, j) = min(i - 1, n - i, j - 1, n - j)
      u(i, j) = .true.
    end do
  end do
  do k = 1, n * n
    i = (p(k) - 1) / n + 1
    j = mod(p(k) - 1, n) + 1
    m = m + h(i, j)
    u(i, j) = .false.
    call dfs(i, j)
  end do
  write(*,'(i0)') m
contains
  recursive subroutine dfs(i, j)
    integer, intent(in) :: i, j
    integer :: k, x, y, d
    d = h(i, j) + merge(1, 0, u(i, j))
    do k = 1, 4
      x = i + di(k)
      y = j + dj(k)
      if (h(x, y) > d) then
        h(x, y) = d
        call dfs(x, y)
      end if
    end do
  end
end program joker

module mod_graph
  implicit none
  integer(8), parameter :: inf = 1000000000000000000_8

  type item
    integer :: id = 0                             !番号
    integer(8) :: wt = 0_8                        !距離の合計
 end type item

  type priorityqueue
    integer :: num = 0                            !要素数
    type(item), pointer :: heap(:) => null()      !配列へのポインタの大きさは無指定
  contains
    !final :: finalizei
 end type priorityqueue

  type edge                                       !辺のこと．ここから可変長配列の実装
     integer :: fm = 0, to = 0, cp = 0, rv = 0
     !from,to,cpはff法の辺の容量，rvは逆辺のリスト上のインデックスの情報
    integer(8) :: wt = 0_8                        !重み(距離とか)
 end type edge

  type arraylist                                   !メソッドの実装，辺に番号付け？
    integer :: num = 0
    type(edge), pointer :: arr(:) => null()
  contains
    procedure :: add => adde
    procedure :: bellman_ford => bellman_ford
    !final :: finalizee
 end type arraylist

  type graph                                       !メソッドの実装，辺と番号，使用状況
    type(arraylist), pointer :: egs(:) => null()   !隣接リスト
    logical, pointer :: used(:) => null()          !dfsで使う
  contains                                         !type文の中にcontain文を入れる
    procedure :: add => add                       !typeの外のサブルーチンへのポインタ
    procedure :: dijkstra => dijkstra
    procedure :: ford_fulkerson => ford_fulkerson
    !final :: finalize
 end type graph

  interface graph                          !interfaceは安全に関数を引数として渡す
    module procedure :: newg               !コンストラクタ
  end interface graph

contains

  function newi(id,wt) result(ret)   !idとwtをitem型のretに入れる
    integer, intent(in) :: id
    integer(8), intent(in) :: wt
    type(item) :: ret
    ret%id = id
    ret%wt = wt
  end function newi

  subroutine swapi(a,b)               !item型であるa,bを入れ替える
    type(item), intent(inout) :: a, b
    type(item) :: c
    c = a
    a = b
    b = c
  end subroutine swapi

  subroutine appendi(a)                         !aの配列長をnから2nにする.O(n)かかる
    type(item), pointer, intent(inout) :: a(:)
    integer :: n
    type(item), allocatable :: tmp(:)
    n = size(a)                                 !配列の要素の合計数
    allocate(tmp(n))
    tmp = a
    deallocate(a)
    allocate(a(2*n))
    a(1:n) = tmp
    deallocate(tmp)
  end subroutine appendi

  function lessi(a,b) result(ret)         !bのwtが大きければ真，そうでなければ偽
    type(item), intent(in) :: a, b
    logical :: ret
    ret = a%wt < b%wt
  end function lessi

  subroutine finalizei(pq)               !pqのリセット
    type(priorityqueue), intent(inout) :: pq
    if (associated(pq%heap)) deallocate(pq%heap)
    pq%num = 0
  end subroutine finalizei

  subroutine offer(pq,it)                !item型であるitをpqに追加する
    type(priorityqueue), intent(inout) :: pq
    type(item), intent(in) :: it
    integer :: i, j
    if (.not.associated(pq%heap)) allocate(pq%heap(1)) !参照先がなければ1番目参照
    if (pq%num == size(pq%heap)) call appendi(pq%heap) !配列長をnから2nに
    pq%num = pq%num+1
    pq%heap(pq%num) = it                 !新たな数値は最後尾に
    i = pq%num
    do while (i > 1)   !逆転がなくなるまで上にあげていく(小さいほうが上)
      j = i/2
      if (lessi(pq%heap(i),pq%heap(j))) call swapi(pq%heap(i),pq%heap(j))
      i = j
    end do
  end subroutine offer

  function poll(pq) result(ret)   !一番上のitem型を取り出す(pqから削除する)
    type(priorityqueue), intent(inout) :: pq
    type(item) :: ret
    integer :: n, i, j
    n = pq%num
    ret = pq%heap(1)
    pq%heap(1) = pq%heap(n)
    pq%num = pq%num-1
    i = 1
    do while (2*i < n)   !最後尾のものを一番上に上げたので，逆転がなくなるまで下ろす
      j = 2*i
      if (j+1 < n .and. lessi(pq%heap(j+1),pq%heap(j))) j = j+1
      if (lessi(pq%heap(j),pq%heap(i))) call swapi(pq%heap(j),pq%heap(i))
      i = j
    end do
  end function poll

  function newe(to,wt,fm,cp,rv) result(ret)   !新しいedgeの生成
    integer, intent(in) :: to
    integer(8), intent(in) :: wt
    integer, intent(in), optional :: fm, cp, rv
    !省略可能な因数の利用(fmはbf法，cp,rvはff法で使用)
    type(edge) :: ret
    if (present(fm)) ret%fm = fm
    ret%to = to
    ret%wt = wt
    if (present(cp) .and. present(rv)) then
      ret%cp = cp
      ret%rv = rv
    end if
  end function newe

  subroutine appende(a)                        !配列長をnから2nに
    type(edge), pointer, intent(inout) :: a(:)
    integer :: n
    type(edge), allocatable :: tmp(:)
    n = size(a)
    allocate(tmp(n))
    tmp = a
    deallocate(a)
    allocate(a(2*n))
    a(1:n) = tmp
    deallocate(tmp)
  end subroutine appende

  function lesse(a,b) result(ret)              !bのwtが大きければ真
    type(edge), intent(in) :: a, b
    logical :: ret
    ret = a%wt < b%wt
  end function lesse

  subroutine finalizee(list)                   !リセット
    type(arraylist), intent(inout) :: list
    if (associated(list%arr)) deallocate(list%arr)
    list%num = 0
  end subroutine finalizee

  subroutine adde(list,e)   !メソッドの処理を書くとき，引数はclass文で宣言.edgeをlistに追加
    class(arraylist), intent(inout) :: list
    type(edge), intent(in) :: e
    if (.not.associated(list%arr)) allocate(list%arr(1))
    if (list%num == size(list%arr)) call appende(list%arr)
    list%num = list%num+1
    list%arr(list%num) = e   !最後尾に追加
  end subroutine adde

  function newg(n) result(ret)   !n番目のgraph型の枠をつくる
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    type(graph) :: ret
    allocate(ret%egs(n))
  end function newg

  subroutine add(g,fm,to,wt,cp)   !graph型にデータを追加
    class(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: fm, to
    integer, intent(in), optional :: cp
    integer(8) :: wt
    if (present(cp)) then
      call adde(g%egs(fm),newe(to,wt,cp=cp,rv=g%egs(to)%num))
      call adde(g%egs(to),newe(fm,wt,cp=0,rv=g%egs(fm)%num-1))
    else
      call adde(g%egs(fm),newe(to,wt))
    end if
  end subroutine add

  subroutine finalize(g)      !リセット
    type(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer :: i
    if (associated(g%used)) deallocate(g%used)
    if (.not.associated(g%egs)) return
    do i = 1, size(g%egs)
      call finalizee(g%egs(i))
    end do
    deallocate(g%egs)
  end subroutine finalize

  function dijkstra(g,s,d) result(ret)   !ダイクストラ法ABC168D，sはstart
    class(graph), intent(in) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: s
    integer(8) :: ret(size(g%egs))     !graph中のlistの数だけ配列をつくる．最短距離を格納
    type(priorityqueue) :: pq
    type(item) :: it
    type(edge) :: e
    integer :: i
    integer :: d(size(g%egs)-1)
    ret = inf
    ret(s) = 0_8
    call offer(pq,newi(s,ret(s)))   !pqにstartの番号とret(s)=0からなるitem型を追加
    do while (pq%num > 0)           !すべて吐き出す
      it = poll(pq)                 !一番上のものを取り出す．次に使う頂点
      if (it%wt > ret(it%id)) cycle
      do i = 1, g%egs(it%id)%num
        e = g%egs(it%id)%arr(i)     !取り出したitemのid番目のlistをeとする
        if (ret(e%to) > ret(it%id)+(e%wt)*d(e%to)) then   !今いる場所からの方が近い
          ret(e%to) = ret(it%id)+(e%wt)*d(e%to)   !最短経路の更新
          if(ret(size(g%egs))==0) return
          call offer(pq,newi(e%to,ret(e%to)))
        end if
      end do
    end do
    call finalizei(pq)
  end function dijkstra

  recursive subroutine dfs_bf(g,u)
    type(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    integer :: i, v
    g%used(u) = .true.
    do i = 1, g%egs(u)%num
      v = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%to
      if (g%used(v)) cycle
      call dfs_bf(g,v)
    end do
  end subroutine dfs_bf

  function bellman_ford(es,s,t) result(ret)   !sはスタート，tはゴール
    class(arraylist), intent(in) :: es
    integer, intent(in) :: s, t
    integer(8) :: ret
    integer :: n, i, fm, to, step
    integer(8) :: wt
    logical :: updated
    integer(8), allocatable :: tmp(:)
    type(graph) :: gs, gt
    type(arraylist) :: reach
    n = 0
    do i = 1, es%num
      n = max(n,es%arr(i)%fm,es%arr(i)%to)
    end do
    gs = newg(n)
    gt = newg(n)
    allocate(gs%used(n),gt%used(n))
    gs%used = .false.
    gt%used = .false.
    do i = 1, es%num
      fm = es%arr(i)%fm
      to = es%arr(i)%to
      wt = es%arr(i)%wt
      call add(gs,fm,to,wt)
      call add(gt,to,fm,wt)
    end do
    call dfs_bf(gs,s)
    call dfs_bf(gt,t)
    n = 0
    do i = 1, es%num
      fm = es%arr(i)%fm
      to = es%arr(i)%to
      if (gs%used(fm) .and. gt%used(fm) .and. gs%used(to) .and. gt%used(to)) then
        call adde(reach,es%arr(i))
        n = max(n,fm,to)
      end if
    end do
    call finalize(gs)
    call finalize(gt)
    allocate(tmp(n))
    tmp = inf
    tmp(s) = 0_8
    step = 0
    updated = .true.
    ret = inf
    do while (updated)
      updated = .false.
      do i = 1, reach%num
        fm = reach%arr(i)%fm
        to = reach%arr(i)%to
        wt = reach%arr(i)%wt
        if (tmp(to) > tmp(fm)+wt) then
          tmp(to) = tmp(fm)+wt
          updated = .true.
        end if
      end do
      step = step+1
      if (step > n) then
        ret = -inf
        exit
      end if
    end do
    if (ret == inf) ret = tmp(t)
    deallocate(tmp)
    call finalizee(reach)
  end function bellman_ford

  recursive function dfs_ff(g,u,t,f) result(ret)
    class(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: u, t, f          !uはスタート,tはゴール？
    integer :: ret
    integer :: i, v, cp, rv
    ret = f
    if (u == t) return
    g%used(u) = .true.
    do i = 1, g%egs(u)%num
      v = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%to
      cp = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%cp
      if (g%used(v) .or. cp <= 0) cycle
      ret = dfs_ff(g,v,t,min(f,cp))
      rv = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%rv
      if (ret > 0) then
        g%egs(u)%arr(i)%cp = g%egs(u)%arr(i)%cp-ret
        g%egs(v)%arr(rv)%cp = g%egs(v)%arr(rv)%cp+ret
        return
      end if
    end do
    ret = 0
  end function dfs_ff

  function ford_fulkerson(g,s,t) result(ret)   !最大流，最小カットを求める
    class(graph), intent(inout) :: g
    integer, intent(in) :: s, t                !スタート，ゴール
    integer :: ret
    integer :: f
    ret = 0
    if (associated(g%used) .and. size(g%used) /= size(g%egs)) deallocate(g%used)
    if (.not.associated(g%used)) allocate(g%used(size(g%egs)))
    do
      g%used = .false.
      f = dfs_ff(g,s,t,1000000000)
      if (f == 0) then
        deallocate(g%used)
        return
      end if
      ret = ret+f
    end do
  end function ford_fulkerson

end module mod_graph

(defun test (n seq)
  (let ((mat (make-array (list n n) :element-type 'uint32 :initial-element #xffffffff))
        (plan (make-array (list n n) :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))
        (res 0))
    (labels ((%get (i j)
               ;; (dbg i j)
               (if (and (<= 0 i (- n 1))
                        (<= 0 j (- n 1)))
                   (aref mat i j)
                   0))
             (decode (p)
               (multiple-value-bind (quot rem) (floor (- p 1) n)
                 (values quot rem))))
      (sb-int:dovector (p (reverse seq))
        (multiple-value-bind (i j) (decode p)
          (setf (aref plan i j) 1))
        (fill (array-storage-vector mat) #xffffffff)
        (dotimes (_ (* n n))
          (dotimes (i n)
            (dotimes (j n)
              (let ((res (min (%get (- i 1) j)
                              (%get (+ i 1) j)
                              (%get i (- j 1))
                              (%get i (+ j 1)))))
                (if (= (aref plan i j) 1)
                    (minf (aref mat i j) (+ res 1))
                    (minf (aref mat i j) res))))))
        (multiple-value-bind (i j) (decode p)
          (setf (aref plan i j) 1)
          (incf res (- (aref mat i j) 1)))
        ;; (println-matrix mat)
        )
      res)))

(defun solve (n ps)
  (declare #.OPT
           (uint16 n)
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) ps))
  (let* (;; 0-bit: up, 1: down, 2: left, 3: right
         (dists (make-array '(500 500) :element-type 'uint8 :initial-element 0))
         (plan (make-array '(500 500) :element-type 'bit :initial-element 1))
         (que (make-queue))
         (res 0))
    (declare (uint16 n)
             (uint32 res))
    (dotimes (i (* n n))
      (setf (aref ps i) (- (aref ps i) 1)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (dotimes (j n)
        (setf (aref dists i j)
              (min (+ i 1) (+ j 1) (- n i) (- n j)))))
    (labels ((decode (p) (floor p n))
             (visit (new-i new-j prev-dist)
               (declare (int32 new-i new-j prev-dist))
               (when (and (<= 0 new-i (- n 1))
                          (<= 0 new-j (- n 1)))
                 (let ((new-dist (+ prev-dist (aref plan new-i new-j))))
                   (when (< new-dist (aref dists new-i new-j))
                     (setf (aref dists new-i new-j) new-dist)
                     (enqueue (cons new-i new-j) que))))))
      (sb-int:dovector (p ps)
        (multiple-value-bind (i j) (decode p)
          (decf (aref dists i j))
          (incf res (aref dists i j))
          (setf (aref plan i j) 0)
          (enqueue (cons i j) que)
          (loop until (queue-empty-p que)
                for (i . j) = (dequeue que)
                for dist = (aref dists i j)
                do (visit (- i 1) j dist)
                   (visit (+ i 1) j dist)
                   (visit i (- j 1) dist)
                   (visit i (+ j 1) dist))))
      res)))

    (println (solve n ps))))

(defun test (n seq)
  (let ((mat (make-array (list n n) :element-type 'uint32 :initial-element #xffffffff))
        (plan (make-array (list n n) :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0))
        (res 0))
    (labels ((%get (i j)
               ;; (dbg i j)
               (if (and (<= 0 i (- n 1))
                        (<= 0 j (- n 1)))
                   (aref mat i j)
                   0))
             (decode (p)
               (multiple-value-bind (quot rem) (floor (- p 1) n)
                 (values quot rem))))
      (sb-int:dovector (p (reverse seq))
        (multiple-value-bind (i j) (decode p)
          (setf (aref plan i j) 1))
        (fill (array-storage-vector mat) #xffffffff)
        (dotimes (_ (* n n))
          (dotimes (i n)
            (dotimes (j n)
              (let ((res (min (%get (- i 1) j)
                              (%get (+ i 1) j)
                              (%get i (- j 1))
                              (%get i (+ j 1)))))
                (if (= (aref plan i j) 1)
                    (minf (aref mat i j) (+ res 1))
                    (minf (aref mat i j) res))))))
        (multiple-value-bind (i j) (decode p)
          (setf (aref plan i j) 1)
          (incf res (- (aref mat i j) 1)))
        ;; (println-matrix mat)
        )
      res)))

             (dotimes (i (* n n))

             (shuffle! vec)
             (assert (= (test n vec) (solve n vec))))))

(defun solve (n ps)
  (declare #.OPT
           (uint16 n)
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) ps))
  (let* (;; 0-bit: up, 1: down, 2: left, 3: right
         (dists (make-array '(500 500) :element-type 'uint8 :initial-element 0))
         (plan (make-array '(500 500) :element-type 'bit :initial-element 1))
         (que-i (make-array #.(* 500 500) :element-type 'uint8))
         (que-j (make-array #.(* 500 500) :element-type 'uint8))
         (front 0)
         (end 0)
         (res 0))
    (declare (uint16 n)
             (uint32 res front end))
    (dotimes (i (* n n))
      (setf (aref ps i) (- (aref ps i) 1)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (dotimes (j n)
        (setf (aref dists i j)
              (min (+ i 1) (+ j 1) (- n i) (- n j)))))
    (labels ((enqueue (i j)
               (setf (aref que-i end) i
                     (aref que-j end) j)
               (incf end))
             (dequeue ()
               (multiple-value-prog1
                   (values (aref que-i front) (aref que-j front))
                 (incf front)))
             (queue-reinitialize ()
               (setq front 0 end 0))
             (visit (new-i new-j prev-dist)
               (declare (int32 new-i new-j prev-dist))
               (when (and (<= 0 new-i (- n 1))
                          (<= 0 new-j (- n 1)))
                 (let ((new-dist (+ prev-dist (aref plan new-i new-j))))
                   (when (< new-dist (aref dists new-i new-j))
                     (setf (aref dists new-i new-j) new-dist)
                     (enqueue new-i new-j))))))
      (sb-int:dovector (p ps)
        (queue-reinitialize)
        (multiple-value-bind (i j) (floor p n)
          (decf (aref dists i j))
          (incf res (aref dists i j))
          (setf (aref plan i j) 0)
          (enqueue i j)
          (loop until (= front end)
                do (multiple-value-bind (i j) (dequeue)
                     (let ((dist (aref dists i j)))
                       (visit (- i 1) j dist)
                       (visit (+ i 1) j dist)
                       (visit i (- j 1) dist)
                       (visit i (+ j 1) dist))))))
      res)))

(defun main ()
  (let* ((n (read))
         (ps (make-array (* n n) :element-type 'uint31 :initial-element 0)))
    (dotimes (i (* n n))
      (setf (aref ps i) (read-fixnum)))
    (println (solve n ps))))

class AtCoderStream
{
    public function readLine($format)
    {
        return fscanf(STDIN, $format);
    }

    public function writeLine($format)
    {
        echo $format, "\n";
    }
}

// export
$stream = new AtCoderStream();

[$N] = $stream->readLine('%d');

$seats = [];
$hates = [];
$arr1  = [];
$arr2  = [];
for ($y = 0; $y < $N; ++$y) {
    $arr1[] = 1;
    $arr2[] = $N;
}
for ($x = 0; $x < $N; ++$x) {
    $seats[] = $arr1;
    $hates[] = $arr2;
}

$hateCount = 0;
for ($Ni = 0, $Nj = $N * $N; $Ni < $Nj; ++$Ni) {
    [$P] = $stream->readLine('%d');
    $Px  = ($P - 1) % $N;
    $Py  = ($P - 1 - $Px) / $N;
    $stream->writeLine("P=$P, Px=$Px, Py=$Py");

    $seats[$Px][$Py] = 0;
    $newHates        = $hates;
    $searchMap       = $hates;

    $newHates[$Px][$Py]  = 0;
    $searchMap[$Px][$Py] = 0;
    $minX                = $Px;
    $minY                = $Py;

    $t=0;
    do {
        if (($minX == 0 || $minX == $N - 1 || $minY == 0 || $minY == $N - 1)
            && $newHates[$minX][$minY] == 0) {
            continue 2;
        }
        $searchMap[$minX][$minY] = -1;
	    findMinHateCount($newHates, $searchMap, $seats, $N, $minX, $minY);
        $stream->writeLine(json_encode($newHates));
        if(++$t > 100){break 2;}

        $minSearch = $N;
        for ($x = 0; $x < $N; ++$x) {
            for ($y = 0; $y < $N; ++$y) {
                $search = $searchMap[$x][$y];
                if ($search > -1 && $search < $minSearch) {
                    $minSearch = $search;
                    $minX      = $x;
                    $minY      = $y;
                }
            }
        }
    } while ($minSearch < $N);

    $minHate = $N;
    for ($i = 0, $j = $N - 1; $i < $j; ++$i) {
        $hate = $newHates[$i][0];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }

        $hate = $newHates[$j][$i];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }

        $hate = $newHates[$j - $i][$j];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }

        $hate = $newHates[0][$j - $i];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }
    }
    $stream->writeLine("hateCount += $minHate");

function findMinHateCount(array &$hates, array &$searchMap, array $seats, int $N, int $x, int $y)
{
    $hate = $hates[$x][$y];

    $newHate = $hate + $seats[$x - 1][$y];
    if ($x - 1 >= 0 && $newHate < $hates[$x - 1][$y]) {
        $hates[$x - 1][$y]     = $newHate;
        $searchMap[$x - 1][$y] = $newHate;
    }

    $newHate = $hate + $seats[$x][$y - 1];
    if ($y - 1 >= 0 && $newHate < $hates[$x][$y - 1]) {
        $hates[$x][$y - 1]     = $newHate;
        $searchMap[$x][$y - 1] = $newHate;
    }

[$N] = $stream->readLine('%d');

for ($y = 0; $y < $N; ++$y) {
    $arr1[] = 1;
    $arr2[] = $N;
}
for ($x = 0; $x < $N; ++$x) {
    $seats[] = $arr1;
    $hates[] = $arr2;

$hateCount = 0;
for ($Ni = 0, $Nj = $N * $N; $Ni < $Nj; ++$Ni) {
    [$P] = $stream->readLine('%d');
    $Px  = ($P - 1) % $N;
    $Py  = ($P - 1 - $Px) / $N;

    $seats[$Px][$Py] = 0;
    $newHates        = $hates;
    $searchMap       = $hates;

    $newHates[$Px][$Py]  = 0;
    $searchMap[$Px][$Py] = 0;
    $minX                = $Px;
    $minY                = $Py;

    do {
        if (($minX == 0 || $minX == $N - 1 || $minY == 0 || $minY == $N - 1)
            && $newHates[$minX][$minY] == 0) {
            continue 2;
        }
        $searchMap[$minX][$minY] = -1;
	    findMinHateCount($newHates, $searchMap, $seats, $N, $minX, $minY);

        $minSearch = $N;
        for ($x = 0; $x < $N; ++$x) {
            for ($y = 0; $y < $N; ++$y) {
                $search = $searchMap[$x][$y];
                if ($search > -1 && $search < $minSearch) {
                    $minSearch = $search;
                    $minX      = $x;
                    $minY      = $y;
                }
            }
        }
    } while ($minSearch < $N);

    $minHate = $N;
    for ($i = 0, $j = $N - 1; $i < $j; ++$i) {
        $hate = $newHates[$i][0];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }

        $hate = $newHates[$j][$i];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }

        $hate = $newHates[$j - $i][$j];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }

        $hate = $newHates[0][$j - $i];
        if ($hate == 0) {
            continue 2;
        } elseif ($hate < $minHate) {
            $minHate = $hate;
        }
    }

function findMinHateCount(array &$hates, array &$searchMap, array $seats, int $N, int $x, int $y)
{
    $hate = $hates[$x][$y];

    $newHate = $hate + $seats[$x - 1][$y];
    if ($x - 1 >= 0 && $newHate < $hates[$x - 1][$y]) {
        $hates[$x - 1][$y]     = $newHate;
        $searchMap[$x - 1][$y] = $newHate;
    }

    $newHate = $hate + $seats[$x][$y - 1];
    if ($y - 1 >= 0 && $newHate < $hates[$x][$y - 1]) {
        $hates[$x][$y - 1]     = $newHate;
        $searchMap[$x][$y - 1] = $newHate;
    }

    $newHate = $hate + $seats[$x + 1][$y];
    if ($x + 1 < $N && $newHate < $hates[$x + 1][$y]) {
        $hates[$x + 1][$y]     = $newHate;
        $searchMap[$x + 1][$y] = $newHate;
    }

    if ($y + 1 < $N && $newHate < $hates[$x][$y + 1]) {
        $hates[$x][$y + 1]     = $newHate;
        $searchMap[$x][$y + 1] = $newHate;
    }
}

type PriorityQueue[T] = object
  data:seq[T]
  comp:proc(x,y:T):int
proc initPriorityQueue[T]():PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:system.cmp[T])
proc initPriorityQueue[T](comp:proc(x,y:T):int):PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:comp)
proc `[]`[T](q: PriorityQueue[T], n: int): T = q.data[n]
proc `[]=`[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], n: int, item: T) = q.data[n] = item
proc len[T](q:PriorityQueue[T]): int = len(q.data)
proc shiftup[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx:int) =
  var i = idx
  while i != 0:
    let p = (i - 1) shr 1
    if q.comp(q[i], q[p]) >= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[i], q.data[p])
    i = p
proc shiftdown[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx: int) =
  var i = idx
  let n = len(q)
  while 2*i + 1 < n:
    var
      a = 2*i + 1
      b = 2*i + 2
    if b < n and q.comp(q[a], q[b]) > 0:
      a = b
    if q.comp(q[i], q[a]) <= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[a], q.data[i])
    i = a
proc push[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], item: T) =
  let n = len(q)
  q.data.add(item)
  shiftup(q, n)
proc pop[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  swap(q.data[0], q.data[^1])
  result = q.data.pop
  shiftdown(q, 0)

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)

type
  SegmentTree*[T] = object
    tree: seq[T]
    leafCount: Positive
    identity: T
    f: proc (x, y: T): T
  SegmentTreeRef*[T] = ref SegmentTree[T]
  SegmentTreeTypes[T] = SegmentTree[T] | SegmentTreeRef[T]

proc initSegmentTree*[T](leafCount: Positive; identity: T; f: proc (x, y: T): T): SegmentTree[T] =
  result = SegmentTree[T](tree: newSeq[T](2 * leafCount), leafCount: leafCount, identity: identity, f: f)
  result.tree.fill(identity)
proc newSegmentTree*[T](leafCount: Positive; identity: T; f: proc (x, y: T): T): SegmentTreeRef[T] =
  result = SegmentTreeRef[T](tree: newSeq[T](2 * leafCount), leafCount: leafCount, identity: identity, f: f)
  result.tree.fill(identity)
proc toSegmentTree*[T](a: openArray[T]; identity: T; f: proc (x, y: T): T): SegmentTree[T] =
  result = SegmentTree[T](tree: newSeq[T](2 * a.len), leafCount: a.len, identity: identity, f: f)
  for i, v in a: result.tree[i + a.len] = v
  for i in countdown(a.high, 1):
    result.tree[i] = f(result.tree[i * 2], result.tree[i * 2 + 1])

proc setValue*[T](self: var SegmentTreeTypes[T]; i: int; value: T) =
  ## 葉の列の ``i`` 番目 (0-indexed) の値を ``value`` に変更する

  var i = i + self.leafCount
  self.tree[i] = value
  while (i = i div 2; i > 0):
    self.tree[i] = self.f(self.tree[i * 2], self.tree[i * 2 + 1])

proc fold*[T](self: SegmentTreeTypes[T]; s: Slice[int]): T =
  ## 葉の列を a とすると，``a[s]`` を ``self.f`` で畳み込んだ結果を返す

  if self.leafCount <= s.a or s.b < 0: return self.identity
  var
    (li, ri) = (max(0, s.a) + self.leafCount, min(self.leafCount, s.b + 1) + self.leafCount)
    left, right = self.identity
  while li < ri:
    if (li and 1) != 0:
      left = self.f(left, self.tree[li])
      li.inc
    li = li div 2
    if (ri and 1) != 0:
      ri.dec
      right = self.f(self.tree[ri], right)
    ri = ri div 2
  self.f(left, right)

proc len*(self: SegmentTreeTypes): int = self.leafCount

proc `[]`*[T](self: SegmentTreeTypes[T]; i: int): T = self.tree[i + self.leafCount]
proc `[]`*[T](self: SegmentTreeTypes[T]; s: Slice[int]): T = self.fold(s)
proc `[]=`*[T](self: var SegmentTreeTypes[T]; i: int; x: T) = self.setValue(i, x)

proc `$`*(segmentTree: SegmentTreeTypes): string = $segmentTree.tree[1 .. ^1]

type PriorityQueue[T] = object
  data:seq[T]
  comp:proc(x,y:T):int
proc initPriorityQueue[T]():PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:system.cmp[T])
proc initPriorityQueue[T](comp:proc(x,y:T):int):PriorityQueue[T] =
  PriorityQueue[T](data:newSeq[T](),
                   comp:comp)
proc `[]`[T](q: PriorityQueue[T], n: int): T = q.data[n]
proc `[]=`[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], n: int, item: T) = q.data[n] = item
proc len[T](q:PriorityQueue[T]): int = len(q.data)
proc shiftup[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx:int) =
  var i = idx
  while i != 0:
    let p = (i - 1) shr 1
    if q.comp(q[i], q[p]) >= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[i], q.data[p])
    i = p
proc shiftdown[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], idx: int) =
  var i = idx
  let n = len(q)
  while 2*i + 1 < n:
    var
      a = 2*i + 1
      b = 2*i + 2
    if b < n and q.comp(q[a], q[b]) > 0:
      a = b
    if q.comp(q[i], q[a]) <= 0:
      break
    swap(q.data[a], q.data[i])
    i = a
proc push[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T], item: T) =
  let n = len(q)
  q.data.add(item)
  shiftup(q, n)
proc pop[T](q: var PriorityQueue[T]): T =
  swap(q.data[0], q.data[^1])
  result = q.data.pop
  shiftdown(q, 0)

def slv(N, P):
    M = N+2
    cost = [0] * M**2
    occupy = [True] * M**2
    for i in range(N):
        im = i*M + M + 1
        for j in range(N):
            cost[im+j] = min(i, j, N-i-1, N-j-1)

    ds = [-1, 1, -M, M]
    ans = 0
    for p in P:
        p -= 1
        x = p // N
        y = p % N
        p = x * M + y + M + 1
        ans += cost[p]
        occupy[p] = False
        s = [p]
        while s:
            pi = s.pop()
            for d in ds:
                ni = pi + d
                nc = cost[pi] + (1 if occupy[pi] else 0)
                if nc < cost[ni]:
                    s.append(ni)
                    cost[ni] = nc
    return ans

def solve(values: List[int], nb: int) -> int:
    # nb of neighbours from here to exit from up, down, left, right
    grid = [[[i, nb - i - 1, j, nb - j - 1] for j in range(nb)] for i in range(nb)]
    # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    answer = 0
    for v in values:
        i, j = divmod(v - 1, nb)
        result = dfs(nb, grid, i, j, set())
        # result = min(grid[i][j])
        # LOG.debug((i, j, result))
        answer += result
        # update neighbours
        if j < nb - 1:
            grid[i][j][RIGHT] = grid[i][j + 1][RIGHT]
        if j > 0:
            grid[i][j][LEFT] = grid[i][j - 1][LEFT]
        if i < nb - 1:
            grid[i][j][UP] = grid[i + 1][j][UP]
        if i > 0:
            grid[i][j][DOWN] = grid[i - 1][j][DOWN]
        for left in range(j):
            grid[i][left][RIGHT] -= 1
            if grid[i][left][RIGHT] < 0:
                grid[i][left][RIGHT] = 0
        for right in range(j + 1, nb):
            grid[i][right][LEFT] -= 1
            if grid[i][right][LEFT] < 0:
                grid[i][right][LEFT] = 0
        for up in range(i):
            grid[up][j][DOWN] -= 1
            if grid[up][j][DOWN] < 0:
                grid[up][j][DOWN] = 0
        for down in range(i + 1, nb):
            grid[down][j][UP] -= 1
            if grid[down][j][UP] < 0:
                grid[down][j][UP] = 0
        # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    return answer


def dfs(
    nb: int, grid: List[List[int]], i: int, j: int, visited: Set[Tuple[int, int]]
) -> int:
    if i <= 0 or i >= nb - 1 or j <= 0 or j >= nb - 1:
        return 0
    if 0 in grid[i][j]:
        return 0
    visited.add((i, j))
    return 1 + min(
        dfs(nb, grid, *neighbour, visited)
        for neighbour in ((i + 1, j), (i - 1, j), (i, j + 1), (i, j - 1))
        if neighbour not in visited
    )

BUFSIZE = 8192


class FastIO(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called, expression-not-assigned
    newlines = 0

    def __init__(self, file):
        self._fd = file.fileno()
        self.buffer = BytesIO()
        self.writable = "x" in file.mode or "r" not in file.mode
        self.write = self.buffer.write if self.writable else None

    def read(self):
        while True:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            if not b:
                break
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines = 0
        return self.buffer.read()

    def readline(self):
        while self.newlines == 0:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            self.newlines = b.count(b"\n") + (not b)
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines -= 1
        return self.buffer.readline()

    def flush(self):
        if self.writable:
            os.write(self._fd, self.buffer.getvalue())
            self.buffer.truncate(0), self.buffer.seek(0)


class IOWrapper(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called
    def __init__(self, file):
        self.buffer = FastIO(file)
        self.flush = self.buffer.flush
        self.writable = self.buffer.writable
        self.write = lambda s: self.buffer.write(s.encode("ascii"))
        self.read = lambda: self.buffer.read().decode("ascii")
        self.readline = lambda: self.buffer.readline().decode("ascii")

        p = 0
        stack[0] = v
        dp[v] = k
        while p >= 0:

def cc_export():
    @njit('(i8, i8[:, :], b1[:], i8[:], i8)')
    def update(n, que, there, cost, pos):
        l = 0
        i = 0

        que[l, 0] = pos
        que[l, 1] = cost[pos] - 1
        # que[l] = pos, cost[pos] - 1
        l += 1

        while i < l:
            pos, dist = que[i]
            i += 1

            if cost[pos] <= dist:
                continue

            y, x = pos // n, pos % n
            cost[pos] = dist

            if y >= 1:
                pp = (y - 1) * n + x
                cc = int(there[pp])
                #que.append((pp, dist + cc))
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1
            if y <= n - 2:
                pp = (y + 1) * n + x
                cc = int(there[pp])
                #que.append((pp, dist + cc))
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1
            if x >= 1:
                pp = y * n + (x - 1)
                cc = int(there[pp])
                #que.append((pp, dist + cc))
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1
            if x <= n - 2:
                pp = y * n + (x + 1)
                cc = int(there[pp])
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1

    @njit('(i8, i8[:])')
    def main(n, p):
        que = np.zeros((4 * n * n, 2), dtype=np.int64)
        there = np.full(n * n, True)
        cost = np.array([
            min(i, n - i - 1, j, n - j - 1) for j in range(n) for i in range(n)
        ],
                        dtype=np.int64)

        ans = 0
        for pos in p:
            ans += cost[pos]
            there[pos] = False
            update(n, que, there, cost, pos)
        return ans

def escape(F,ys,xs,n):
  if xs==0 or xs==n-1 or ys==0 or ys==n-1 or V[ys][xs]:
    return 0
  

  G = [[INF]*n for _ in range(n)]
  G[ys][xs] = 0
  
  que = [(0,ys,xs)] 
  while len(que)>0:
    c,y,x = heapq.heappop(que)    
    if x==0 or x==n-1 or y==0 or y==n-1:            
      return c
    
    for dy,dx in ((0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,0)):
      nx = dx+x
      ny = dy+y
      
      if G[ny][nx] > G[y][x]:
        G[ny][nx] = G[y][x] + F[ny][nx]
        if G[ny][nx] == 0:
          V[ny][nx] = False
        heapq.heappush(que,(G[ny][nx],ny,nx))

def solve(values: List[int], nb: int) -> int:
    # nb of neighbours from here to exit from up, down, left, right
    grid = [[[i, nb - i - 1, j, nb - j - 1] for j in range(nb)] for i in range(nb)]
    # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    answer = 0

        # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    return answer


def update_neighbours(
    nb: int, grid: List[List[int]], i: int, j: int, free_exit: Set[Tuple[int, int]]
):
    # update neighbours
    if j < nb - 1:
        grid[i][j][RIGHT] = grid[i][j + 1][RIGHT]
    if j > 0:
        grid[i][j][LEFT] = grid[i][j - 1][LEFT]
    if i < nb - 1:
        grid[i][j][UP] = grid[i + 1][j][UP]
    if i > 0:
        grid[i][j][DOWN] = grid[i - 1][j][DOWN]
    if 0 in grid[i][j]:
        free_exit.add((i, j))
    for left in range(j):
        grid[i][left][RIGHT] -= 1
        if grid[i][left][RIGHT] < 0:
            grid[i][left][RIGHT] = 0
            free_exit.add((i, left))
    for right in range(j + 1, nb):
        grid[i][right][LEFT] -= 1
        if grid[i][right][LEFT] < 0:
            grid[i][right][LEFT] = 0
            free_exit.add((i, right))
    for up in range(i):
        grid[up][j][DOWN] -= 1
        if grid[up][j][DOWN] < 0:
            grid[up][j][DOWN] = 0
            free_exit.add((up, i))
    for down in range(i + 1, nb):
        grid[down][j][UP] -= 1
        if grid[down][j][UP] < 0:
            grid[down][j][UP] = 0
            free_exit.add((down, i))


def dfs(
    nb: int,
    grid: List[List[int]],
    i: int,
    j: int,
    free_exit: Set[Tuple[int, int]],
    visited: Set[Tuple[int, int]],
) -> int:
    if i <= 0 or i >= nb - 1 or j <= 0 or j >= nb - 1:
        return 0
    if (i, j) in free_exit:
        return 0
    if 0 in grid[i][j]:
        return 0
    visited.add((i, j))
    return 1 + min(
        dfs(nb, grid, *neighbour, free_exit, visited)
        for neighbour in ((i + 1, j), (i - 1, j), (i, j + 1), (i, j - 1))
        if neighbour not in visited
    )

    return answer


def dfs(
    nb: int,
    grid: List[List[int]],
    removed_i: int,
    removed_j: int,
    still_inside: List[List[bool]],
):
    q = deque([(removed_i, removed_j, grid[removed_i][removed_j])])
    while q:
        i, j, cur_cost = q.pop()
        for next_i, next_j in (
            (i + 1, j),
            (i - 1, j),
            (i, j + 1),
            (i, j - 1),
        ):
            if (
                0 <= next_i < nb
                and 0 <= next_j < nb
                and grid[next_i][next_j] > cur_cost + still_inside[i][j]
            ):
                grid[next_i][next_j] = cur_cost + still_inside[i][j]
                q.append((next_i, next_j, grid[next_i][next_j]))

def solve(n, ppp):
    n2 = n + 2
    nsq = n2 * n2
    seats = np.zeros(nsq, dtype=np.int16)
    is_seated = np.zeros(nsq, dtype=np.int8)
    for i in range(n):
        ud = min(i, n - 1 - i)
        ri = (i + 1) * n2
        for j in range(n):
            ij = ri + j + 1
            seats[ij] = min(ud, j, n - 1 - j)
            is_seated[ij] = 1

    MOVES = np.array([-n2, -1, 1, n2], dtype=np.int16)

    ans = 0

    for pi in range(n * n):
        i, j = divmod(ppp[pi], n)
        i = (i + 1) * n2 + j + 1
        res = seats[i]
        ans += res
        is_seated[i] = 0

        deque = [(0, 0)] * nsq
        l, r = 0, 0
        for mi in range(4):
            ni = i + MOVES[mi]
            if seats[ni] > res:
                deque[r] = (res, ni)
                r += 1

        while l != r:
            val, j = deque[l]
            # print(val, j, deque)

            if seats[j] <= val:

            seats[j] = val

            else:

                    nj = j + MOVES[mi]

                        l = (l - 1) % nsq

    cost = [0] * M**2
    occupy = [True] * M**2
    for i in range(N):
        im = i * (M+1)
        for j in range(N):
            cost[im + j + 1] = min(i, j, N-i-1, N-j-1)

        s = [p]

                ni = pi + d
                nc = cost[pi] + (1 if occupy[pi] else 0)
                if nc < cost[ni]:
                    s.append(ni)
                    cost[ni] = nc
    return ans

def calc(N, M, A, X, Y):

            for d in dd:

    return ans

def dijkstra(s,graph,n):
    dist=[float("inf") for i in range(n+1)]
    dist[s]=0
    pq=[]
    heapq.heapify(pq)
    heapq.heappush(pq,(0,s))
    while pq:
        mini_dis,node=heapq.heappop(pq)
        if dist[node]<mini_dis: continue
        for w,point in graph[node]:
            if dist[point]<w:continue
            newlen=dist[node]+w
            if newlen<dist[point]:
                heapq.heappush(pq,(newlen,point))
                dist[point]=newlen
    return dist

def slv(N, P):
    P = [p-1 for p in P]
    M = N+2
    cost = [0] * M**2
    occupy = [True] * M**2
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            cost[i*M+j + M + 1] = min(i, j, N-i-1, N-j-1)

    ans = 0
    for p in P:
        x = p // N
        y = p % N
        p = x * M + y + M + 1
        ans += cost[p]
        occupy[p] = False
        s = [p]
        while s:
            pi = s.pop()
            for d in [-1, 1, -M, M]:
                ni = pi + d
                nc = cost[pi] + (1 if occupy[pi] else 0)
                if nc < cost[ni]:
                    s.append(ni)
                    cost[ni] = nc
    return ans

        # que[l] = pos, cost[pos] - 1

            if cost[pos] <= dist:

            y, x = divmod(pos, n)

                cc = int(there[pp])
                #que.append((pp, dist + cc))
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1
            if y <= n - 2:
                pp = (y + 1) * n + x
                cc = int(there[pp])
                #que.append((pp, dist + cc))
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1
            if x >= 1:

                cc = int(there[pp])
                #que.append((pp, dist + cc))
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1
            if x <= n - 2:
                pp = y * n + (x + 1)
                cc = int(there[pp])
                que[l] = (pp, dist + cc)
                l += 1

    people = [[True] * N for i in range(N)]
    for j in range(N):
        x = min(j, N-1-j)
        for i in range(N):
            dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], x)

    def bfs(sy, sx):
        que = deque([(sy, sx, dp[sy][sx])])
        popleft = que.popleft; append = que.append
        while que:
            y, x, cur = popleft()
            cur += people[y][x]
            for dy, dx in zip([0, 1, 0, -1], [1, 0, -1, 0]):
                ny = y + dy
                nx = x + dx
                if 0 <= ny < N and 0 <= nx < N:
                    if dp[ny][nx] > cur:
                        dp[ny][nx] = cur
                        append((ny, nx, cur))

    answer = 0

        p -= 1
        i = p // N
        j = p % N
        answer += dp[i][j]
        people[i][j] = False
        bfs(i, j)

class gridMan:

    s.W = len(s.L[0])
  def makeWall(s, x = -2):
    w = len(s.L[0]) + 2
    s.L = [[x] * w] + [[x] + i + [x] for i in s.L] + [[x] * w]
  def dist(s, S): 
    ans = min(S[0] - 1, S[1] - 1)
    ans = min(ans, N - S[0], N - S[1])
    T = [[-1] * (s.W + 2) for _ in range(s.H + 2)]
    q = queue.Queue()
    q.put([S[0], S[1]])
    T[S[0]][S[1]] = 0
    k = 0
    while not q.empty():
      h, w = q.get()
      k = T[h][w]
      for i, j in [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]:
        hh = h + i
        ww = w + j
        if s.L[hh][ww] == -2:
          ans = min(ans, k)
          if ans == 0:
            return ans
          continue
        kk = k + s.L[hh][ww]
        if kk > ans: continue
        if T[hh][ww] > kk or T[hh][ww] == -1:
          q.put([hh, ww])
          T[hh][ww] = kk
    return ans

def solve(values: List[int], nb: int) -> int:
    # min nb of neighbours from here to exit
    grid = [[min(i, nb - i - 1, j, nb - j - 1) for j in range(nb)] for i in range(nb)]
    answer = 0
    still_inside = [[True] * nb for _ in range(nb)]
    # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    for v in values:
        i, j = divmod(v - 1, nb)
        answer += grid[i][j]
        # LOG.debug((i, j, grid[i][j]))
        still_inside[i][j] = False
        new_score = min(
            still_inside[next_i][next_j] + grid[next_i][next_j]
            for next_i, next_j in ((i + 1, j), (i - 1, j), (i, j + 1), (i, j - 1))
            if 0 <= next_i < nb and 0 <= next_j < nb
        )
        if new_score < grid[i][j]:
            grid[i][j] = new_score
        dfs(nb, grid, i, j, still_inside)
        # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    return answer


def dfs(
    nb: int,
    grid: List[List[int]],
    removed_i: int,
    removed_j: int,
    still_inside: List[List[bool]],
):
    q = deque([(removed_i, removed_j)])
    while q:
        i, j = q.pop()
        for next_i, next_j in (
            (i + 1, j),
            (i - 1, j),
            (i, j + 1),
            (i, j - 1),
        ):
            if (
                0 <= next_i < nb
                and 0 <= next_j < nb
                and grid[next_i][next_j] > grid[i][j] + still_inside[i][j]
            ):
                grid[next_i][next_j] = grid[i][j] + still_inside[i][j]
                if still_inside[i][j]:
                    q.append((next_i, next_j))
                else:
                    q.appendleft((next_i, next_j))


def update_neighbours(nb: int, grid: List[List[int]], i: int, j: int):
    # update neighbours
    if j < nb - 1:
        grid[i][j][RIGHT] = grid[i][j + 1][RIGHT]
    if j > 0:
        grid[i][j][LEFT] = grid[i][j - 1][LEFT]
    if i < nb - 1:
        grid[i][j][UP] = grid[i + 1][j][UP]
    if i > 0:
        grid[i][j][DOWN] = grid[i - 1][j][DOWN]
    for left in range(j):
        grid[i][left][RIGHT] = max(0, grid[i][left][RIGHT])
    for right in range(j + 1, nb):
        grid[i][right][LEFT] = max(0, grid[i][right][LEFT])
    for up in range(i):
        grid[up][j][DOWN] = max(0, grid[up][j][DOWN])
    for down in range(i + 1, nb):
        grid[down][j][UP] = max(0, grid[down][j][UP])

BUFSIZE = 8192


class FastIO(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called, expression-not-assigned
    newlines = 0

    def __init__(self, file):
        self._fd = file.fileno()
        self.buffer = BytesIO()
        self.writable = "x" in file.mode or "r" not in file.mode
        self.write = self.buffer.write if self.writable else None

    def read(self):
        while True:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            if not b:
                break
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines = 0
        return self.buffer.read()

    def readline(self):
        while self.newlines == 0:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            self.newlines = b.count(b"\n") + (not b)
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines -= 1
        return self.buffer.readline()

    def flush(self):
        if self.writable:
            os.write(self._fd, self.buffer.getvalue())
            self.buffer.truncate(0), self.buffer.seek(0)


class IOWrapper(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called
    def __init__(self, file):
        self.buffer = FastIO(file)
        self.flush = self.buffer.flush
        self.writable = self.buffer.writable
        self.write = lambda s: self.buffer.write(s.encode("ascii"))
        self.read = lambda: self.buffer.read().decode("ascii")
        self.readline = lambda: self.buffer.readline().decode("ascii")

    D = [N, -N, 1, -1]
    # Q[p]: 行動の最初にそのマスを踏んだ場合の、脱出までの最短コスト
    # 取り除いたマスは符号を反転する
    Q = [0 for _ in P]
    q = deque()
    cache = set()
    NN = N * N
    ans = 0

    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            k = i * N + j
            Q[k] = min(i, j, N-i-1, N-j-1) + 1
    
    x = 0
    for p in P:
        q.clear()
        cache.clear()
        r = INF
        for dp in D:
            np = p + dp
            if 0 <= np < NN and abs(np%N - p%N) < N-1:
                r = min(r, abs(Q[np]))
            else:
                r = 0
        
        ans += r
        Q[p] = -r
        q.append(p)
        while q:
            pp = q.popleft()
            for dp in D:
                np = pp + dp
                if 0 <= np < NN and abs(np%N - pp%N) < N-1 and np not in cache:
                    qnp, qpp = Q[np], Q[pp]
                    # 4隣接が除去済みマスなら、コストなしで到達可能
                    if qnp < 0 and abs(qnp) > abs(qpp):
                        Q[np] = abs(qpp) * sign(qnp)
                        q.append(np)
                        cache.add(np)
                    elif qnp > 0 and abs(qnp) > abs(qpp) + 1:
                        Q[np] = (abs(qpp) + 1) * sign(qnp)
                        q.append(np)
                        cache.add(np)
    return ans

@njit
def solve(N, P):
    W = N + 2
    dp = np.zeros((W, W), np.int32)
    for _ in range(4):
        dp = dp.T[::-1]
        for n in range(1, (N + 1) // 2 + 1):
            dp[n, n:-n] = n
    filled = np.zeros_like(dp)
    filled[1:-1, 1:-1] = 1
    dp = dp.ravel()
    filled = filled.ravel()
    stack = np.empty_like(dp)
    ans = 0
    for n in P:
        n -= 1
        h, w = divmod(n, N)
        v = (h + 1) * W + (w + 1)
        ans += dp[v] - 1
        filled[v] = 0
        k = min(dp[v - 1], dp[v + 1], dp[v - W], dp[v + W])
        if dp[v] == k:
            return ans
        p = 0
        stack[0] = v
        dp[v] = k
        while p >= 0:
            v = stack[p]
            p -= 1
            for dx in (-1, 1, -W, W):
                w = v + dx
                k = dp[v] + filled[w]
                if dp[w] > k:
                    dp[w] = k
                    p += 1
                    stack[p] = w
    return ans

def bfs(start, ch, reached):

    moves = 0
    heapq.heappush(queue, (start[0], start[1], moves))
    ans = []

        for _ in range(len(queue)):
            x, y, o_move = heapq.heappop(queue)
            for dx, dy in tests:
                tx, ty = x + dx, y + dy

                            reached[tx][ty] = o_move
                            heapq.heappush(queue_next, (tx, ty, o_move))
                        else:
                            reached[tx][ty] = o_move + 1
                            heapq.heappush(queue_next, (tx, ty, o_move + 1))

                else:
                    ans.append(o_move)

        queue = queue_next

    return min(ans)

def solve(values: List[int], nb: int) -> int:
    # nb of neighbours from here to exit from up, down, left, right
    grid = [[[i, nb - i - 1, j, nb - j - 1] for j in range(nb)] for i in range(nb)]
    # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    answer = 0
    for v in values:
        i, j = divmod(v - 1, nb)
        result = dfs(nb, grid, i, j, set())
        # LOG.debug((i, j, result))
        answer += result
        # update neighbours
        if j < nb - 1:
            grid[i][j][RIGHT] = grid[i][j + 1][RIGHT]
        if j > 0:
            grid[i][j][LEFT] = grid[i][j - 1][LEFT]
        if i < nb - 1:
            grid[i][j][UP] = grid[i + 1][j][UP]
        if i > 0:
            grid[i][j][DOWN] = grid[i - 1][j][DOWN]
        for left in range(j):
            grid[i][left][RIGHT] = max(0, grid[i][left][RIGHT] - 1)
        for right in range(j + 1, nb):
            grid[i][right][LEFT] = max(0, grid[i][right][LEFT] - 1)
        for up in range(i):
            grid[up][j][DOWN] = max(0, grid[up][j][DOWN] - 1)
        for down in range(i + 1, nb):
            grid[down][j][UP] = max(0, grid[down][j][UP] - 1)
        # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    return answer


def dfs(
    nb: int, grid: List[List[int]], i: int, j: int, visited: Set[Tuple[int, int]]
) -> int:
    if i <= 0 or i >= nb - 1 or j <= 0 or j >= nb - 1:
        return 0
    if min(grid[i][j]) == 0:
        return 0
    visited.add((i, j))
    return 1 + min(
        dfs(nb, grid, *neighbour, visited)
        for neighbour in ((i + 1, j), (i - 1, j), (i, j + 1), (i, j - 1))
        if neighbour not in visited
    )

BUFSIZE = 8192


class FastIO(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called, expression-not-assigned
    newlines = 0

    def __init__(self, file):
        self._fd = file.fileno()
        self.buffer = BytesIO()
        self.writable = "x" in file.mode or "r" not in file.mode
        self.write = self.buffer.write if self.writable else None

    def read(self):
        while True:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            if not b:
                break
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines = 0
        return self.buffer.read()

    def readline(self):
        while self.newlines == 0:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            self.newlines = b.count(b"\n") + (not b)
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines -= 1
        return self.buffer.readline()

    def flush(self):
        if self.writable:
            os.write(self._fd, self.buffer.getvalue())
            self.buffer.truncate(0), self.buffer.seek(0)


class IOWrapper(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called
    def __init__(self, file):
        self.buffer = FastIO(file)
        self.flush = self.buffer.flush
        self.writable = self.buffer.writable
        self.write = lambda s: self.buffer.write(s.encode("ascii"))
        self.read = lambda: self.buffer.read().decode("ascii")
        self.readline = lambda: self.buffer.readline().decode("ascii")

def solve(n, ppp):
    n2 = n + 2
    nsq = n2 * n2
    seats = np.zeros(nsq, dtype=np.int16)
    is_seated = np.zeros(nsq, dtype=np.int8)
    for i in range(n):
        ud = min(i, n - 1 - i)
        ri = (i + 1) * n2
        for j in range(n):
            ij = ri + j + 1
            seats[ij] = min(ud, j, n - 1 - j)
            is_seated[ij] = 1
    # print(seats.reshape((n2, n2)))

    MOVES = np.array([-n2, -1, 1, n2], dtype=np.int32)

    ans = 0

    # popped = 0

    for pi in range(n * n):
        i, j = divmod(ppp[pi], n)
        i = (i + 1) * n2 + j + 1
        res = seats[i]
        ans += res
        is_seated[i] = 0

        deque = [(0, 0)] * nsq
        l, r = 0, 0
        for mi in range(4):
            ni = i + MOVES[mi]
            if seats[ni] > res:
                deque[r] = (res, ni)
                r += 1

        while l != r:
            val, j = deque[l]
            # popped += 1
            # print(val, j, seats[j], l, r)
            l = (l + 1) % nsq
            if seats[j] <= val:
                continue
            seats[j] = val

            if is_seated[j]:
                val += 1
                for mi in range(4):
                    nj = j + MOVES[mi]
                    if seats[nj] > val:
                        deque[r] = (val, nj)
                        r = (r + 1) % nsq
            else:
                for mi in range(4):
                    nj = j + MOVES[mi]

def calc(N, M, A, X, Y):
    ans = 0
    for a in A:
        aa = (a // N + 1) * M + a % N + 1
        ans += X[aa]
        h = X[aa]
        if h < 0: continue
        Q = [(aa, h)]

        Y[aa] = 0
        dd = (-1, 1, M, -M)

            i, h = Q[q]

            for d in dd:
                j = i + d
                y = Y[j]
                if X[j] >= h + y:
                    X[j] -= 1
                    Q.append((j, h + y))
    return ans

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(10**7)
    INF = 10**3
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    LI = lambda : [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.readline().split()]
    NI = lambda : int(sys.stdin.readline())
    SI = lambda : sys.stdin.readline().rstrip()

    N = NI()
    P = LI()

    seat = [[1] * N for _ in range(N)]
    zero = [[1] * N for _ in range(N)]

    ans = 0

    for i in P:
        x = (i-1) % N
        y = (i-1) // N

        dp = [[INF] * N for _ in range(N)]
        d = 0
        q = []
        heapify(q)
        heappush(q,(d,x,y))
        dp[x][y] = 0
        min_cnt = INF
        while q:
            d,i,j = heappop(q)
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)):
                if not(0 <= i+di < N and 0 <= j+dj < N):
                    break
                if zero[i+di][j+dj] == 0:
                    break
                e = seat[i+di][j+dj]
                if dp[i+di][j+dj] > d+e:
                    dp[i+di][j+dj] = d+e
                    heappush(q,(d+e,i+di,j+dj))
            else:
                continue
            min_cnt = d
            break

        seat[x][y] = 0
        if min_cnt == 0:
            q = collections.deque()
            q.append((x,y))
            zero[x][y] = 0
            while q:
                i,j = q.popleft()
                for di,dj in ((1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)):
                    if not(0 <= i+di < N and 0 <= j+dj < N): continue
                    if seat[i+di][j+dj] == 1 or zero[i+di][j+dj] == 0: continue
                    zero[i+di][j+dj] = 0
                    q.append((i+di,j+dj))
        ans += min_cnt
    print(ans)

def solve(values: List[int], nb: int) -> int:
    # nb of neighbours from here to exit from up, down, left, right
    grid = [[[i, nb - i - 1, j, nb - j - 1] for j in range(nb)] for i in range(nb)]
    # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    answer = 0
    for v in values:
        i, j = divmod(v - 1, nb)
        # result = dfs(nb, grid, i, j, set())
        result = min(grid[i][j])
        # LOG.debug((i, j, result))
        answer += result
        # update neighbours
        if j < nb - 1:
            grid[i][j][RIGHT] = grid[i][j + 1][RIGHT]
        if j > 0:
            grid[i][j][LEFT] = grid[i][j - 1][LEFT]
        if i < nb - 1:
            grid[i][j][UP] = grid[i + 1][j][UP]
        if i > 0:
            grid[i][j][DOWN] = grid[i - 1][j][DOWN]
        for left in range(j):
            grid[i][left][RIGHT] -= 1
            if grid[i][left][RIGHT] < 0:
                grid[i][left][RIGHT] = 0
        for right in range(j + 1, nb):
            grid[i][right][LEFT] -= 1
            if grid[i][right][LEFT] < 0:
                grid[i][right][LEFT] = 0
        for up in range(i):
            grid[up][j][DOWN] -= 1
            if grid[up][j][DOWN] < 0:
                grid[up][j][DOWN] = 0
        for down in range(i + 1, nb):
            grid[down][j][UP] -= 1
            if grid[down][j][UP] < 0:
                grid[down][j][UP] = 0
        # LOG.debug(("\n".join(map(str, grid))))
    return answer


def dfs(
    nb: int, grid: List[List[int]], i: int, j: int, visited: Set[Tuple[int, int]]
) -> int:
    if i <= 0 or i >= nb - 1 or j <= 0 or j >= nb - 1:
        return 0
    if min(grid[i][j]) == 0:
        return 0
    visited.add((i, j))
    return 1 + min(
        dfs(nb, grid, *neighbour, visited)
        for neighbour in ((i + 1, j), (i - 1, j), (i, j + 1), (i, j - 1))
        if neighbour not in visited
    )

BUFSIZE = 8192


class FastIO(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called, expression-not-assigned
    newlines = 0

    def __init__(self, file):
        self._fd = file.fileno()
        self.buffer = BytesIO()
        self.writable = "x" in file.mode or "r" not in file.mode
        self.write = self.buffer.write if self.writable else None

    def read(self):
        while True:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            if not b:
                break
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines = 0
        return self.buffer.read()

    def readline(self):
        while self.newlines == 0:
            b = os.read(self._fd, max(os.fstat(self._fd).st_size, BUFSIZE))
            self.newlines = b.count(b"\n") + (not b)
            ptr = self.buffer.tell()
            self.buffer.seek(0, 2), self.buffer.write(b), self.buffer.seek(ptr)
        self.newlines -= 1
        return self.buffer.readline()

    def flush(self):
        if self.writable:
            os.write(self._fd, self.buffer.getvalue())
            self.buffer.truncate(0), self.buffer.seek(0)


class IOWrapper(IOBase):
    # pylint: disable=super-init-not-called
    def __init__(self, file):
        self.buffer = FastIO(file)
        self.flush = self.buffer.flush
        self.writable = self.buffer.writable
        self.write = lambda s: self.buffer.write(s.encode("ascii"))
        self.read = lambda: self.buffer.read().decode("ascii")
        self.readline = lambda: self.buffer.readline().decode("ascii")


def configure_log() -> None:

    handler = logging.StreamHandler(IOWrapper(sys.stderr))
    handler.setFormatter(log_formatter)
    LOG.addHandler(handler)

def solve(N, P):
    W = N + 2
    dp = np.zeros((W, W), np.int32)
    for _ in range(4):
        dp = dp.T[::-1]
        for n in range(1, (N + 1) // 2 + 1):
            dp[n, n:-n] = n
    filled = np.zeros_like(dp)
    filled[1:-1, 1:-1] = 1
    dp = dp.ravel()
    filled = filled.ravel()
    stack = np.empty_like(dp)
    ans = 0
    for n in P:
        n -= 1
        h, w = divmod(n, N)
        v = (h + 1) * W + (w + 1)
        ans += dp[v] - 1
        filled[v] = 0
        k = min(dp[v - 1], dp[v + 1], dp[v - W], dp[v + W])
        if dp[v] == k:
            return ans
        p = 0
        stack[0] = v
        dp[v] = k
        while p >= 0:
            v = stack[p]
            p -= 1
            for dx in (-1, 1, -W, W):
                w = v + dx
                k = dp[v] + filled[w]
                if dp[w] > k:
                    dp[w] = k
                    p += 1
                    stack[p] = w
    return ans

def solve(n, ppp):
    n2 = n + 2
    nsq = n2 * n2
    seats = np.zeros(nsq, dtype=np.int16)
    is_seated = np.zeros(nsq, dtype=np.int8)
    for i in range(n):
        ud = min(i, n - 1 - i)
        ri = (i + 1) * n2
        for j in range(n):
            ij = ri + j + 1
            seats[ij] = min(ud, j, n - 1 - j)
            is_seated[ij] = 1

    MOVES = np.array([-n2, -1, 1, n2], dtype=np.int16)

    ans = 0

    for p in ppp:
        i, j = divmod(p - 1, n)
        i = (i + 1) * n2 + j + 1
        res = seats[i]
        ans += res
        is_seated[i] = 0

        deque = [(0, 0)] * nsq
        l, r = 0, 4
        for dj in MOVES:
            deque[l] = (res, i + dj)
            l += 1
        l = 0

        while l != r:
            val, j = deque[l]
            # print(val, j, deque[l:r] if l >= 0 else deque[l:] + deque[:r])
            l = (l + 1) % nsq
            if seats[j] <= val:
                continue
            seats[j] = val

            if is_seated[j]:
                val += 1
                for dj in MOVES:
                    nj = j + dj
                    if seats[nj] > val:
                        deque[r] = (val, nj)
                        r = (r + 1) % nsq
            else:
                for dj in MOVES:
                    nj = j + dj
                    if seats[nj] > val:
                        l = (l - 1) % nsq
                        deque[l] = (val, nj)

    return ans
